title: The aim
text: One player is the judge for the round and reads a question card aloud. Everyone else answers with the funniest card in their hand. The judge picks a favourite, and that player takes the point.

title: A round
text:
Everybody holds a hand of answer cards. The judge reads the question. Each other player passes one answer face down. The judge shuffles them, reads them out and chooses.

The winner keeps the question card as a point. Everyone draws back up, and the next player becomes the judge.

title: Ending
text: Play to a number of points you agree before starting, or until the snacks run out. Tap a name here to give the point. Press the button to pass the judge's seat along.
